ObjectName.value: ARKIVET (statsarkiv 1935-40, 1945-97, Gestapo HQ 1942-45, Fredssenter 2001-) Nybygg 2018 Peace and Human Rights Centre Minnebauta Memorial. Vesterveien 4, Bellevue, Kristiansand NORWAY IMG 3687

Categories.value: Arkivet, Kristiansand|Self-published work|Norway photographs taken on 2023-10-17|Memorial stones in Norway|World War II memorials in Agder

ImageDescription.value:
ARKIVET Peace and Human Rights Center in Kristiansand, Norway, was Gestapo's headquarters in Southern Norway from 1942 to 1945, during the German occupation of Norway during the Second World War.
  • ARKIVET Peace and Human Rights Centre:
The Regional State Archives in Kristiansand opened in 1935. When the Nazis arrived in 1940, the Archives' new building was taken over by the German military and later their Security Police. After the war, the Regional State Archives returned and remained until 1997. After extensive restoration, a center for history communication and peace building opened in 2001. A connected structure, a substantial addition with a café, a lecture hall, and more, opened in 2018.
